Name: GValley Dynamic Dialogues
Author: Zerlony0
Description:
[center][b]G-Valley: Dynamic Dialogues[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[i]"Hello! You can call me Zerlony. I'm new to modding and this is my very first project. I started developing G-Valley because I wanted a deeper immersion in Stardew Valley. After playing around with generative AI (LLMs), I thought: 'Why not put this in my farming game?'.[/i]
[i]I decided to share this work with the community because I believe that, just like me, many veterans who have played and replayed Stardew are looking for that extra 'flavor' and completely new, living interactions with the villagers." [/i]
[i]- Zerlony [/i]

[left][center][b]📢 Languages[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
The mod currently supports two languages: English and Brazilian Portuguese. In the future, I plan to add support for all other languages available in the base game.[/left]
[center][b]🌟 Key Features[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*][b]Dynamic Dialogues:[/b] Chat naturally with NPCs through a custom text box.[/*]
[*][b]Multi-Model Support:[/b] Compatible with Google Gemini, OpenAI (GPT-4o), OpenRouter (Claude, Llama 3, etc.), or local models via llama.cpp/Ollama.[/*]
[*][b]Contextual Awareness:[/b] NPCs know your name, the current weather, the season, your exact location, and your friendship level. They can casually comment on the green rain in summer or a festival taking place.[/*]
[*][b]Conversational Memory:[/b] The mod keeps a history of recent interactions, allowing NPCs to remember the flow of current and past conversations as your game progresses.[/*]
[*][b]Dynamic Portraits:[/b] The AI selects the correct NPC facial expression (happy, sad, angry, etc.) based on the tone of their response.[/*]
[*][b]Authentic Personalities:[/b] Uses detailed YAML profiles to ensure Mr. Qi remains enigmatic, Jodi sounds like a caring mother, and Clint keeps his trademark shyness.[/*]
[*][b]Friendship Impact:[/b] Your words carry weight! Depending on what you say, your friendship score with the NPC can increase or decrease.[/*]
[/list][center][b]🥸 Custom Portraits[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[left]Inside the Mods/GValley/portrait folder, you will find an image file named player.png. 
You can replace it with your own custom portrait—just make sure to rename your new image to player.png.
Tip: If you want to create a custom portrait that matches the game's art style, I highly recommend using the
 [url=https://jazzybee.itch.io/sdvcharactercreator]Stardew Valley Character Creator[/url] by Jazzybee (available on itch.io).
[/left]
[center][b]🛠️ How It Works[/b][/center]

The mod intercepts interactions and sends a "context package" to your selected AI, including:
[list=1]
[*][b]NPC Profile:[/b] Backstory, motivations, and secrets.[/*]
[*][b]World State:[/b] Date, time, weather, and current location.[/*]
[*][b]History:[/b] What was said previously.[/*]
[/list][i]The AI then responds in JSON format, which the mod processes to display the dialogue and update the game state in real-time.[/i]

[center][b]⚙️ Configuration[/b][/center]

The prompt_settings.json file in the mod's root folder allows you to translate the system instructions and adjust how the AI should behave.

[center][b]🔑 How to get your API Key[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
For the mod to work, you will need an API key. If you are looking for a free model, I highly recommend using Google Gemini:
[list=1]
[*]Go to Google AI Studio, OpenAI, or OpenRouter.[/*]
[*]Log in with your account.[/*]
[*]Click on "Get API key".[/*]
[*]Copy the key and paste it into your config.json file (this file is generated after launching the game for the first time with the mod installed).[/*]
[/list][center][b]📦 Requirements[/b]
Stardew Valley 1.6+
SMAPI 4.0.0+[/center]
[center][/center]
[center][b]🚀 Installation[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[center]Install SMAPI.
Extract the mod's contents into your game's Mods folder.
Run the game once to generate the config.json file.
Open the config.json file and insert your ApiKey.[/center]
[center]Have fun chatting![/center]
[center]
[b]🛠️ Troubleshooting (FAQ)[/b][/center]
[center][/center]
[list]
[*][b]The NPC is not responding:[/b] Check if your API key is correctly pasted in config.json and ensure you have an active internet connection.[/*]
[*][b]Rate Limit Error (Quota):[/b] The free Gemini tier has a limit on requests per minute. If too many messages are sent in a short amount of time, the NPC might become "speechless" for a moment. Just wait a bit.[/*]
[*][b]The game crashes when opening the menu:[/b] Make sure the prompt_settings.json file is located in the root of the mod folder, and NOT inside the i18n folder.[/*]
[/list][line]
[i]Developed by Zerlony. Make your farm life much more alive with the power of AI.[/i]
[i]Want to see how the magic happens behind the scenes? [b]G-Valley[/b] is open-source and available on GitHub! Whether you are a developer looking to contribute and expand the mod, or a player who found a bug and wants to open an Issue, feel free to visit the repository. All help and feedback are incredibly welcome! 👉 [url=https://github.com/Zerlony6/Gvalley]Github[/url][/i]
